name: Banh uot in Con
summary: Bánh ướt in Cộn is a thin rice sheet, steamed for a few dozen seconds, smooth and chewy. Du khách, the Quảng Trị visitor desk, places the craft in Đồng Sơn, where more than 16 households still make bún and bánh by hand.
origin: Cộn, phường Đồng Sơn, Đồng Hới. Du khách on 4 Aug 2023, republishing Báo Quảng Bình.
texture: The 4 Aug 2023 article calls the sheet thin, smooth, and both chewy and soft. Rice is soaked, ground, and rested one day and one night, depending on the weather, then steamed a few dozen seconds.
howToEat: Buy the sheet hot. Households sell the sheets for the house and for parties.
where: Cộn, phường Đồng Sơn. One kitchen sits in a lane behind the Đồng Sơn primary school.
